decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The wall coverings, plaster etc shall be carefully stripped to reveal any underlying timber frame that may exist, in addition to that which is already visible. If any further timber framework is found no part shall be cut or removed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority. A sample of the plasterboard metal stud work that would cover these timbers should be submitted for written approval by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Art Gallery incorporating the installation of 2 new windows to south elevation, formation of a new plant room in the basement level storage area with the installation of a pair of metal louvred doors & 4 condensor units.
